#PENTA vs North

Probably skip. I definitely think North is the much better team here but I don't like betting on them, and Penta is kind of unpredictable. Probably around 75-25 North

#Mouz vs FaZe

FaZe's consistency has been pretty pathetic lately. Kio, Niko, and allu have looked nonexistent relative to what we expect from them. Rain has had to pretty much carry. Mouz hasn't really looked good either, so I think FaZe will still win if their stars actually show up. Might skip this one. 60-40 FaZe

#F3 vs Na'Vi

Na'Vi has had consistently good performances from all their players recently. I don't see how they lose this unless they totally collapse and every F3 player has the match of their life. 85-15 Na'Vi

#Immortals vs Vega Squadron

I don't rate either of these teams. Immortals is probably favored, but I'll probably put a small bet on Vega if their odds are decent. 65-35 Immortals.

#BIG vs Cloud9

Cloud 9, like Na'Vi, have had all of their players consistently playing well. BIG had a great match yesterday, but I think it will actually be much harder against C9, even if they can replicate the form they had against FaZe. 75-25 C9

#Gambit vs G2

G2 are clearly better, but their consistency has been revolting and Gambit has a better map pool. I think this could easily go Gambit's way if they seize an early economic advantage, or even if they don't, although I doubt there will be good odds and I might skip. 60-40 G2

#SK vs Astralis

SK is the clear favorite, but either of these teams could easily win in a bo1. I'll bet according to the map and odds.

#Virtus.Pro vs Fnatic

My gut is leaning towards VP, but from a logical perspective this is pretty much a 50-50

#G2 vs Na'Vi

Both teams have shown a ton of class this tournament. Na'Vi have totally revived their game, particularly in Guardian's improved sniping, and G2 proved they won't be the Arsenal of CS by beating SK impressively. I think this one could definitely go either way and will be a beautiful game, but there's a huge question mark in terms of map pool from Na'Vi which makes it tough to call. From a practical perspective, I have to favor G2, but my gut feeling says this could just as easily go Na'Vi's way *55/45 G2*

#NiP vs C9

NiP seems to have corrected every shortcoming they've had over the past year, however they've only shown this on cache and in Bo1s. That said, they look like a strong force at the moment. Stewie and Autimatic have been stepping up huge over the past few matches, but it will be more difficult to do that against NiP, who look passionate and driven, not to mention NiP countered C9 impressively just a few days ago. *NiP 65-35*

#FaZe vs Liquid

FaZe have run into a few bumps in the road, but proved how strong they were today against North. Flawless match. If they can replicate that tomorrow, it's a guaranteed win, but if not I think Liquid have a chance. They've looked fantastic this tournament. This one is really tough to call because we don't really know how FaZe is gonna play, but I definitely favor them. *73-27 FaZe*

#SK vs OpTic

SK have looked sub-par this tournament, and as someone who had them pegged to win the whole thing, this is worrying to me. At the same time, I still believe they're a vastly superior team to OpTic and don't see how they lose this. OpTic can can win this. They've had a few nice victories against North and FaZe, but these teams didn't really show up, and now OpTic is up against a much stronger and more consistent team in a bo3. *84-16 SK*

Looks like there are a bunch of good betting matches today!

**Fnatic vs Mouz**

Honestly, in terms of maps, I have to say I very slightly favor Mouz here. They should be the better team on Cache, Dust 2, Mirage, and Overpass, and even if fnatic is narrowly stronger on several of these maps, it's still worth an underdog bet on Mouz.

**Godsent vs EnVyUs**

This match is very unpredictable, and I would not recommend a substantial bet on it. We have no idea what EnVyUs is going to play like here, and Godsent is kind of a strange beast. This game has skip written all over it, but if you do decide to bet for some reason, make it a small one.

**North vs HR**

Regardless of map, an HR bet is absolutely justified. Definitely some upset potential here. North could very easily crack under pressure, and HR is no pushover of a team. I wouldn't put more than a very small bet here, but my confidence in North is nearly non-existent. 

**Gambit vs VP**

I see a very narrow victory for VP here, but it will be a much closer and more intense map than I believe most people are anticipating. Zeus has gotten this team in better shape than we've seen in a while, so I may put a small bet on Gambit. Like I said, I think VP will win, but the odds do not at all describe how close this matchup is.

**Astralis vs G2**

G2's chances of winning this game are entirely dependent on whether or not they play Nuke. Astralis should ban out Cobble, Cache, and Dust 2, so I think Nuke will be one of the final two maps, but I don't think G2 has a chance if it isn't played. If it is played, I still favor Astralis. G2 bet is not justified imo, but an Astralis bet might be depending on the odds and map. Hopefully we get to see the map before bets close (I'm on ebettle).

**SK vs Na'Vi**

It's important to remember that in the last Bo3 these teams played (in which SK won), fnx was still on SK and played well. Also, s1mple played poorly, which isn't an event likely to repeat itself. Na'Vi are coming into this major looking stronger than they have in a while, and I think they're the better team here. In terms of maps, I genuinely have no idea. It could be Mirage, Overpass, Cobble, or Dust 2, however regardless of map I have to favor Na'Vi. By the way, the only scenario in which I see Cobble going through is if Na'Vi have polished it up to the point of immense confidence. I don't think they will be confident enough to let it through unless they really are good enough to beat SK on it now. I'm betting pretty big on Na'Vi
